newsitem.title: USA: Trism sees Q4 loss of $0.35/shr.
newsitem.headline: Trism sees Q4 loss of $0.35/shr.

text.p: Trism Inc said Friday it expects a fourth-quarter loss of about $0.35 per share, with an estimated $0.09 due to income tax treatment.

The company said group healthcare costs and a loss on a sale of equipment hurt fourth-quarter results. It also said fuel costs and market demand in the flatbed segment of its business hurt the operational results of two divisions, Trism Heavy Haul and Trism Transport.
The trucking company said it plans to release its financial results in early Febraury.
